hero.title: Business Management in France for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Study Business Management in France, acquiring comprehensive expertise across organizational strategy, financial analysis, operational leadership, and corporate governance. International students master real-world business acumen and access post-study stay-back authorizations under French immigration policy.

overview: Indian students who choose to study Business Management in France get a chance to learn and develop professional skills in business, leadership, entrepreneurship, and management. France is a popular destination for international students, offering a wide range of higher-education institutions, from public universities to internationally recognized business schools and specialized management schools.

A Business Management course in France can equip students with skills in strategic planning, marketing, finance, human resources, operations, and international business. English is the language of instruction in many institutions, but there are also many courses on offer in French. Campus France advises on management and business administration studies for international students.
With Edu Hawk global study abroad guidancestudents can explore these opportunities along with the requirements involved in pursuing education abroad.

sections.title: Eligibility to Study PG Business Management In France
sections.lead: The \\Business Management PG eligibility criteria in France\\ differ between universities, business schools and individual programs. Many postgraduate management courses will accept graduates from a variety of academic backgrounds, although some specialist degrees will require prior knowledge of a specific subject.

items: A recognized bachelor degree or equivalent qualification.
Academic transcripts and proof of previous educational qualifications
English language proficiency for courses taught in English or French language proficiency for courses taught in French.
A CV or résumé outlining professional and academic experience.
Statement of Purpose (SOP), or motivation letter.
Entrance test scores, references or an interview as required by the institution.

sections.title: Business Management Admission in France
sections.lead: applicants should check out the requirements for the course they have chosen as business schools may have different selection methods.

items: A recognized undergraduate qualification is generally required for a postgraduate program. Some institutions will accept graduates from non-business disciplines but if you have a finance or analytics specialization you may need to have studied it previously.

English-language programs may require IELTS, TOEFL or another accepted form of evidence of English-language proficiency. The required scores and exemptions vary and so applicants should check the current rules of the program.
French proficiency proof may be required for courses taught in French. Students should inquire about the language level required and the certificates that are accepted by the institution.
Entrance Test and Interview

Depending on the program, applicants may be asked to take the GMAT, GRE, TAGE MAGE or another accepted test. Some schools will interview applicants, others will ask for essays, group exercises or other types of selection.
Work Experience
Work experience is particularly crucial for executive and MBA programs. A pre-experience Master of Management may be available to students with limited full-time professional experience.

sections.title: The Cost of Studying Business Management in France
sections.lead: \\The cost of studying Business Management in France\\ will depend on the institution, the program, your nationality, the city and whether you qualify for any fee exemptions. Public universities and private business schools can have very different fee structures.

items: Tuition Fees for 2026–2027
The references for annual registration fees for public higher-education institutions in France covered by the national tuition-fee system are:
Bachelor's degree \| €178 \| €2,902
Master's degree \| €255 \| €3,950
Doctoral Degree \| 398 \| 398
These are national public-institution rates and not the price of every Business Management course. Some programs or institutions may have different fee arrangements and exemptions may apply.
Other Expenses
Students are expected to:
Housing and utilities.
Daily and food costs.
Public transportation.
Books, study materials and equipment.
insurance and health-related costs, if applicable.
Visa related costs and the proper Student and Campus Life Contribution (CVEC).
Cost of living depends on where you live. Larger cities like Paris can be pricier than smaller university towns, especially in terms of housing.

International students can apply for government scholarships, institutional scholarships, exchange funding and other eligible financial-aid schemes. Each opportunity has its own set of eligibility criteria and application deadlines.

sections.title: Business Management Admission in France
sections.lead: The \\Business Management admission process in France\\ depends on the program, nationality, qualification and institution.

items: 1. \\Choose your programme:\\ Decide between a bachelor's degree, a Master in Management, a specialized master's or an MBA.
2. \\Institutions to shortlist:\\ Consider curriculum, language of instruction, tuition fees, recognition of the qualification and location.
3. \\Check Eligibility:\\ Make sure you have the academic prerequisites, work experience requirements and accepted language tests.
4. \\Prepare your documents:\\ You'll need academic transcripts, degree certificates, CV, motivation letters and references.
5. \\Entrance Tests:\\ If required, take admission or language tests and prepare for interviews.
6. \\Submit through the institution's application portal or the application pathway that is relevant to your situation. Some applicants will be required to apply through a specific process.
7. \\Check Your Offer:\\ Review the conditions, deposit, fee schedule and closing dates for enrollments.
8. \\Organize your student visa:\\ Follow the official French visa instructions for your case.
9. \\Final Enrolment:\\ Provide final documentation and fulfill the institution's registration requirements.

sections.title: Recognition And Accreditation
sections.lead: Students should confirm the precise qualification awarded by the institution before accepting an offer. \\Master in Management, MSc, MBA and master's degree\\ do not automatically mean that each program has the same status in the French higher education system.

items: Students should verify:
If the program leads to a national Master's degree or a qualification at Master level.
If the institution and the particular program have the appropriate official recognition or accreditation.
Registration of the qualification in the French national framework of professional certification, where applicable.
whether the award is adequate for further education or employment in the country where the student intends to work

sections.title: Business Management in France: Salary and Job Opportunities
sections.lead: A \\Business Management qualification in France\\ will equip graduates for a variety of positions in consulting, finance, marketing, retail, technology, manufacturing, hospitality and international trade.

items: Graduates can apply for positions like:
Business Development Executive
Strategy or Management Consultant.
Marketing Executive or Brand Manager.
Project Manager or Project Coordinator.
Operational Manager.
Human Resources Specialist.
Business Analyst.
Account Executive.
Logistics or supply chain coordinator.
Business Owner/Entrepreneur.
Expected Salary
The salary of Business Management graduates in France is not set.
Earnings are dependent on role, employer, location, degree, experience, language skills and sector.
Entry-level jobs in business typically don't require specialized skills or prior experience like consulting, finance and management jobs do.

sections.title: Documents Required
sections.lead: Exact document checklist will depend on institution and program.

items: Accepted identity document or valid passport.
Degree Certificate or Provisional Certificate for post graduate applications.
Academic history, including transcripts and grades.
Abstract.
Statement of Purpose (SOP) or Letter of Motivation
Test results in English or French if required.
Letters of recommendation, as appropriate.
Scores of GMAT, GRE or other entrance tests, if applicable.
Proof of work experience for MBA or executive programs where applicable.
Certified translations of documents not accepted in the original language.
Application form duly filled and the application fee, if applicable.
Any other documents requested by the institution or by the visa authorities.
If you are still working on your degree, you may be asked to submit current transcripts and proof of expected graduation.
Students are always advised to follow the institution's instructions for the format, certification and submission of documents.

faqs.q: Is France a good country for studying Business Management?
faqs.a: In France, you will find a range of public universities and business schools offering programs in general management, international business, finance, marketing and entrepreneurship. Applicants should compare the curriculum, cost, qualification status and careers services before choosing a program.

faqs.q: The cost of Business Management in France is?
faqs.a: For 2026-2027, the regular registration cost for a master's program at a public institution is €255 per year for EU/EEA/Swiss students and €3,950 for non-EU students, subject to differentiated fees. Private business schools and some specialist programs charge different fees, often higher.

faqs.q: Do you need work experience to get a Master's in Business Management?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Many MiM programs for those without previous experience will accept recent graduates with little or no full-time work experience. Most MBA and executive programs usually require students to have some professional experience, so be sure to check the specific requirements.

faqs.q: What jobs can I do after studying Business Management in France?
faqs.a: Career opportunities include Business Analyst, Marketing Executive, Project Coordinator, Consultant, Operations Specialist, Human Resources Professional and Business Development Executive. Career outcomes will vary depending on the student's specialization, experience, language ability and work authorization.
